question: Which praiseworthy and locality-associated divine forms receive homage in this invocation?
premises: Homage is directed to the praiseworthy aspect.
Homage is directed to the one dwelling at the end.
Homage extends to dwellers of fertile soil and the threshing floor.
inference: Divine presence is honored across praiseworthy qualities and specific earthly localities.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of āvasānyāya as a place or state is context-dependent.
plain_english: Homage to the praiseworthy and to the one dwelling at the end; homage to the one of the fertile soil and to the one of the threshing floor.
